$comment: High or critical advisories accepted for a limited time (spec §4.14 dependency scanning; scripts/audit-gate.mjs). Each entry names who reviews it and by when; an expired entry blocks CI again.

advisories.reason: Used by the Expo command-line tool on developer machines and in CI builds, not shipped in the app bundle or run by the API. Fixed by the Expo SDK upgrade that moves @expo/cli to zod >= 4.6.6.

Shipped in the customer app through expo-router's query-string 7.1.3, which requires decode-uri-component ^0.2.2; the fix is in the 0.5 line, a breaking range for query-string. It decodes the app's own route parameters, and verified links are limited to SPORTSPARK_VERIFIED_LINK_HOSTS (DEC-061). Fixed by the expo-router upgrade.
